proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9875.2 *maricca gives Punjabi marc/mirc, Bhojpuri maricā ‘chillies’, Awadhi mircā and Gujarati marcī/marcũ ‘red pepper’. The chilli meaning is an attested later extension of the pepper family. Palatal versus sibilant outcomes and local transmission need review; this is not a claim that chilli was the ancient referent.

Its addenda derive vaḍra by extraction from formations such as evaḍa/kevaḍa, ultimately involving -vant plus -ḍa; this is not a simple direct descent from vṛddha. Regional vowel and liquid variation remains for triage.
